text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*... Sleepy. Maybe I'll have some 
herbal tea and take an afternoon nap~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Warm the mug up~, put the tea leaves 
in~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Now to set the timer app— Oh, an 
UmaTube notification popped up~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, today's stream was so soothing too~. 
Nature ASMR really makes you lose track of 
time――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Hishi Miracle ended up feeling 
down after drinking the super bitter 
herbal tea...
